metadata.title: Orbifold Morse Handles I. Morse Indices and Isomorphism Classes of Ordered Handles
metadata.abstract: We classify the Morse indices and ordered handles arising from nondegenerate critical points of smooth functions on effective orientable four-dimensional orbifolds. Let $\rho\colon G\to\mathrm{SO}(4)$ be a faithful representation of a finite group. Let $V\subset\mathbb R^4$ be the negative eigenspace of a nondegenerate Hessian that is invariant under $\rho(G)$. The splitting $\mathbb R^4=V\oplus V^\perp$ determines an ordered quotient handle. Two such ordered handles admit an orientation-preserving isomorphism if and only if their negative eigenspaces lie in the same orbit under $N_{\mathrm{SO}(4)}(\rho(G))$. We determine the possible Morse indices and the normalizer orbits for every family in the completed Du Val list.
